assessment: The price increase from Harbourline Dry Goods Pte Ltd is partially in line with market trends, but a significant portion is unexplained. Further review is needed to understand the additional cost. [E1][E4]

verified_facts.text: The price of cooking oil from Harbourline Dry Goods Pte Ltd increased by 17.8% from April to September 2026, from S$3.700 to S$4.360 per liter.
The global market for palm oil decreased by 1.6% and soybean oil increased by 7.7% from April to July 2026.

From April to July 2026, the price increase of 7.6% for cooking oil from Harbourline Dry Goods Pte Ltd is 4 percentage points higher than the market average of 3.1%. An additional 9.5% increase occurred after the latest market data.

possible_explanations.text: The initial 7.6% price increase could be justified by market trends, but the additional 9.5% increase is not supported by available market data.

missing_evidence: Detailed breakdown of the additional 9.5% price increase from Harbourline Dry Goods Pte Ltd.
